kurzbeschreibung:
**Finally in Sankt Anton am Arlberg!** --- **

Welcome to the heart of the Alps

** Discover the magic of **Tirol**—where breathtaking mountain landscapes, world-class skiing, and authentic alpine culture await you. **Sankt Anton am Arlberg** is the perfect starting point for unforgettable adventures. --- **

Skiing & Snowboarding

** The **Arlberg** ski area is one of the most famous in the world, offering over **360 km of perfectly groomed slopes** for all levels. Whether you're a beginner or a pro, you’ll find your perfect run here. After a day on the slopes, warm up with a **Kaiserschmarrn** and a **Apfelstrudel** at one of our cozy mountain huts. --- **

Culture & Tradition

** Experience the unique charm of **Tirol** in **Innsbruck**, just a short drive away. Visit the **Goldenes Dachl**, explore the **Alpenzoo**, or stroll through the historic old town. In **Sankt Anton**, you’ll find traditional **Tiroler Gaststätten** serving hearty dishes like **Schlutzkrapfen** and **Kaspressknödel**. --- **

Summer Adventures

** When the snow melts, the **Arlberg** transforms into a paradise for hikers, mountain bikers, and golfers. Try the **Arlberg High Route**, one of the most scenic hiking trails in the Alps, or relax in the **Therme Längenfeld** for a well-deserved break. --- **

Your Home Away from Home

** Stay in a charming **Almhütte**, a luxurious **5-star hotel**, or a cozy **Ferienwohnung**—**Sankt Anton** has the perfect accommodation for every traveler. Whether you're here for winter sports, summer relaxation, or just to soak in the alpine atmosphere, you’ll leave with memories that last a lifetime. --- **

Plan Your Trip

** Ready to explore? Check out our **events calendar**, **lift passes**, and **hotel deals** to make the most of your stay in **Sankt Anton am Arlberg**—where every season is an adventure!
